ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.INTER_REASON' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.inter_reason',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.INTER_CODE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.inter_code',action);
 end if;

 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);

 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_inter_reason',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_inter_code_ctrl', action); 
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_inter_reason',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_inter_code_ctrl',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
end if;
END;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :valid_regint_reasons.inter_reason is not null and
 :valid_regint_reasons.inter_code is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_regint_reasons
 WHERE inter_reason = :valid_regint_reasons.inter_reason and
 inter_code = :valid_regint_reasons.inter_code; 
 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 end if;
 end if; /* 1st if then */
 END IF;
END;
